name: Reverse Lunge with Overhead Reach
steps: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart and arms hanging at your sides.
Step your right foot straight backward and lower your body into a reverse lunge until both knees are bent at roughly 90 degrees.
As you sink into the lunge, reach both arms overhead and slightly backward, opening up your chest and the front of your right hip.
Lower your arms as you push through your front left heel to return to the standing position.
Repeat the movement by stepping back with your left foot.
coaching_cues: A reverse lunge places significantly less shear stress on the front knee than a forward lunge.
Keep your front knee stacked over your front ankle without caving inward.
Inhale as you step back and reach overhead; exhale as you return to stand.
